{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only (per population in contract)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Remove QA orders
cleaned_data = sales[~qa_mask]
completed_clean = cleaned_data[cleaned_data['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by customer_segment and compute conversion rate
conversion_rates = completed_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print("Conversion rates by segment (in percent):")
print(conversion_rates)

# Output
print(f"\nBest segment: {best_segment} ({best_rate:.2f}%)")"}
